scope: Seven parent-selected lowered-reference positives only; original reference file unchanged.
selection_disclosure: Parent identified these as model-lowered reference positives after freezing the model. No predictions, scores, reports, selections beyond the supplied seven identities, or other reviewer outputs were read. This targeted post-evaluation audit is selection-conditioned and cannot estimate overall error rates.
rubric: Label changed Go functions review when their changed behavior affects access/tenant/object authorization, a disclosure boundary, executable capability or effect-ceiling enforcement, identity isolation, or directly asserts one of those invariants in a test (including extracted assertion helpers). Label generic plumbing, fixture setup, test doubles, pure serialization, effect accounting, evidence-integrity checks, and happy-path retry tests routine unless their changed behavior itself implements or asserts such a boundary. Supporting a security test or living in a security package alone is insufficient. Label unknown when the causal link cannot be resolved from pinned source and inspected caller context. Relevance is not a defect finding; routine is only out of scope for this authorization task and does not mean safe to omit from every review.
limitations: Task relevance only, not defect truth.
Same reviewing agent reconsidered its own reference; independent or human adjudication may disagree.
Pinned caller inspection, no runtime tests or training.
A narrow rubric still includes policy-bearing projections and actual host writer capability issuance/revocation, while excluding generic serialization, telemetry and storage integrity.

records.adjudication_rationale: Release checks durable token ownership, marks the current authority inactive and calls loseLocked, which removes the current lease, closes loss notification and releases the OS authority lock. Engine mutation checks then reject that tenure. Retain review for capability revocation.
records.counterargument_considered: File persistence alone would be routine. This function also performs the live permission-state transition, so it cannot be reduced to evidence integrity or cleanup serialization.

records.adjudication_rationale: The test attempts actual authority acquisition from an invalid manifest and requires refusal, then verifies the failed acquisition released the exclusive authority lock. Acquire would otherwise establish a live process lease and token. Retain review as direct fail-closed writer-capability construction assertion.
records.counterargument_considered: A decoder-only malformed JSON test or generic missing-dependency constructor test would be routine. This invokes the capability-issuing operation and asserts no acquisition; it directly covers the authority boundary rather than merely validating stored bytes.
